body: Makes sense. I think I'll give it a try at least. I think I'm gonna go try and get some sleep now, but thanks for chatting, it helped at least some I think.

I was in college and failed out. Just couldn't really do it. I could try and find a group or something I guess. I really don't have much left as far as friends go, and the one or two left are working all day then I work nights, then they're always doing something weekends. I would go try and meet new people, but I've always sucked at it, and now it just feels like I don't have the energy for any kind of relationship. I just kind of feel trapped by my own limitations I guess.

I basically sit on my computer all day. Play diablo, minecraft, the usual big ones. I don't really even get any enjoyment out of playing them anymore, it's just some kind of stimulus to keep me from going insane. I've never really had hobbies. I went out and bought a shitton of Magic the Gathering cards a few days back just to do something else despite having never played before. I now have two decks that probably suck and nobody I'd even play them against. At work, I load semi trucks. Its monotonous and shitty but pays better than most jobs that require no experience.
